primaryTextRead.text: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

wikipediaRead.title: Eshtemoa
wikipediaRead.locator: Eshtemoa article lines 140–143, People subsection: distinguishes city and two personal-name uses; 4:19 item is listed as descendant of Bithiah and Mered.
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 英語版記事の人物項目は、歴代誌上4:19のエシュテモアをビテヤとメレドの子孫として挙げる。ただし固定WEBの節から個別の親子関係までは確定しない。
